en.hook: A runnable CDC stack that captures PostgreSQL WAL changes with Debezium, normalizes events in Python, and publishes analytics-ready bronze, silver, and gold layers with dbt and Streamlit.
en.body:
A runnable CDC stack that captures PostgreSQL WAL changes with Debezium, normalizes events in Python, and publishes analytics-ready bronze, silver, and gold layers with dbt and Streamlit.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Open the project case on the site and inspect the GitHub implementation.
